_meta.notes: Uruguayan Zen is Sōtō, split between an AZI/Deshimaru-derived dōjō and the Asociación Zen del Uruguay.

places.name: Asociación Zen del Uruguay — Zendo de los Tres Tesoros
places.notes: Uruguay’s civil-society map, updated in 2024, lists the association at Hugo Pratto 2212 and names Daigo Moriyama Rōshi. The group’s published weekly timetable is much older, so confirm current practice before attending.

places.name: Dōjō Zen de Montevideo
places.address: Rambla Concepción del Uruguay 4632, Malvín, Montevideo, Uruguay
places.notes: The current Kōsen Sangha page identifies Ryu Kyu Dojo at this address and publishes its regular zazen schedule.
